title: Carry a stand into a corner

source.task: 任务将面前散落放置的支架移动到角落里。 拯起双手向前移动到支架前方，用右手缓缓靠近支架，然后抓住握紧，然后向上用力，然后转身，然后移动到角落里，然后右手缓缓往下一，待支架稳定。 稳定放到地面上后松开右，缓缓松开右手，然后双手归位，任务结束。

handCoverage.criterion: DynHaMR valid & visible at original 30 fps; PICO hand_active

quality.criterion: Raw 30 Hz geodesic rotation continuity; no missing body/hands; no smoothing

cameraMount: Illustrative chest placement, forward and pitched downward 30 degrees; no calibrated camera extrinsics supplied.

hands.source: DynHaMR smooth_fit world.npz pose_body only; neutral MANO shape
hands.leftConvention: MANO_RIGHT mirrored along X, including triangle winding
hands.wristPlacement: Native rest axes; rigid attachment to PICO-driven SMPL wrists; no world-frame calibration
hands.transition: Biharmonic forearm displacement; shared MANO wrist vertices
